messages:
lina: Quick sync: I've been experimenting with a tiny "bloom+mini-index" manifest to avoid full-index parsing on hosted while keeping private deploys integrity-safe. Want to run the tradeoffs here.

jin: Bloom-filter sounds promising for membership tests. Low memory, fast negative responses. But FP rate means we need a cheap secondary probe (e.g. range-CRC) before committing warmup resources.

alex: Thinking staged validation: 1) manifest header + signature check, 2) bloom membership + first-chunk probe, 3) async full-CRC validation in background. Private deploys require step 1 to be signed by customer KMS. Hosted may skip KMS but still use signer for provenance.

maria: For private/offline: we still need an index-first mode for a full, signed manifest verification step (air-gapped). But we can keep that offline and produce a "manifest-lite" artifact the runtime consumes at boot. That keeps TTFI low in practice.

lina: Proposed manifest-lite fields (pseudo):
```json
{"version":"v1","bloom":"base64...","shards":[{"id":"s0","size":1234,"first_range_crc":"abcd"}],"lease_ttl_s":120}
```
Uses bloom for membership, first_range_crc for quick-probe, lease_ttl for warmstart reservation.

jin: Good. On false-positive: runtime should attempt open_chunk(shard,0,probe_len) and verify first_range_crc before scheduling activation. If that fails, mark shard degraded and trigger repair fetch.

alex: Reservation/lease idea is important. When a model activation begins we issue a reservation token which pins those shards for lease_ttl seconds to avoid eviction while the prefix warms. After lease expiry eviction score decays.

maria: Eviction scoring note: eviction_score = base_score + (activation_rank * -alpha) + (reserved ? -inf : 0) + recent_use_bonus. Means earlier-activation shards get lower eviction priority.

deploy-bot: [deploy:weighting-service/v2] ingest-adapter pod restarted 1x since 06:12 UTC - rolling back config not recommended.

jin: Also think about progressive checksums: keep a rolling CRC table (cheap) for the first N chunks so probe_len can be tiny (e.g., 4KB) but still catch common corruptions. Full validation remains async.

lina: Format adapters: runtime expects a single read_chunk(shard_id, offset, len) -> stream. At ingest time we attach an adapter that translates safetensors/tar/zip into that API. That keeps runtime format-agnostic.

alex: Telemetry contract to surface to Console: weight.ingest.manifest.signed, weight.ingest.bloom.fp_rate, weight.warmup.reservation. Also a shard state: ACTIVE | RESERVED | DEGRADED | MISSING.

maria: Ops checklist for private: validate-manifest-offline, sign-with-customer-kms, upload-manifest-lite, run repair-scan post-deploy. I'll draft and attach to RFC.

jin: I'll hack a small PoC that emits manifest-lite and serves read_chunk endpoints (gRPC) by EOW. Will include a sim for bloom FP impact on warmup latency.

lina: I'll run eviction sim with lease TTLs and activation ranks to show hit-rate improvements.

alex: Good plan. Next: capture this as an RFC follow-up (manifest-lite + adapter ABI + reservation protocol + telemetry). 30m sync once PoC + sims ready. Thanks all :thumbsup:
